question: Should Discord guild/channel config support an opt-in list of role IDs whose mentions count as explicit wake signals for every configured agent receiving that message?
rationale: The feature adds public configuration and deliberate multi-agent fan-out, while direct bot mention was previously confirmed as the intentional default; source evidence cannot choose that product policy.

options.title: Add opt-in wake roles
options.body: Add a separate role-ID list that activates only on configured matching role mentions and leaves existing defaults unchanged.

options.title: Defer to access redesign
options.body: Define mentioned-role wake semantics as part of the broader Discord access-policy redesign at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/69748.

options.title: Keep direct mentions only
options.body: Decline role-based fan-out and retain direct bot mention as the only role-specific wake mechanism.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in wake roles
recommendation.body: Add a separate role-ID list that activates only on configured matching role mentions and leaves existing defaults unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest sustained ownership of the affected Discord preflight, routing, and configuration boundaries.
